newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates down on 1.3-bln-rupee inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates down on 1.3-bln-rupee inflow.

text.p: Pakistani interbank rates ended down on Tuesday on an inflow of 1.3 billion rupees of matured paper sold in an open market operation, dealers said.
They said rates could firm on Wednesday when the State (central) Bank of Pakistan may mop up liquidity in an OMO.
Overnights stayed low on Tuesday with most deals struck at 1.5 to 3.0 percent, a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.

The central bank auctioned three-, five- and 10-year federal investment bonds, receiving bids worth 1.380 billion rupees, and was likely to announce the result on Wednesday with settlement set for Thursday, the dealer said.
